properties.description: G22 rewrite of P22_LookupSemantics. A plain join under the CI collation would match 'p-100' and 'P-100 ' and return both P-200 rows; this query reproduces the SSIS full-cache Lookup instead.

activities.name: Lookup ProductCode
activities.description: Byte-exact lookup, first duplicate wins, NULL matches a NULL reference key, as the SSIS full-cache Lookup did.

source.sqlReaderQuery:
WITH ref AS (
    -- SSIS full cache keeps the first row of a duplicate key (its reference query is ORDER BY RefId).
    SELECT ProductCode, Category,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(ProductCode AS varbinary(20)) ORDER BY RefId) AS rn
      FROM pty.G22_Reference
)
SELECT i.InputId, i.ProductCode, r.Category,
       CAST(CASE WHEN r.rn IS NULL THEN 'NoMatch' ELSE 'Match' END AS varchar(10)) AS MatchStatus
  FROM pty.G22_Input AS i
  LEFT JOIN ref AS r
    ON r.rn = 1
   -- The cache compares bytes: case and trailing spaces matter, and NULL matches a NULL reference key.
   AND (CAST(i.ProductCode AS varbinary(20)) = CAST(r.ProductCode AS varbinary(20))
        OR (i.ProductCode IS NULL AND r.ProductCode IS NULL));
